website = {{Url|https://www.kotak.bank.in|www.kotak.bank.in}} }} '''Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited''' is an Indian [[banking]] and [[financial services]] company headquartered in [[Mumbai]]. It offers banking products and financial services for corporate and retail customers in the areas of [[personal finance]], [[investment banking]], [[life insurance]], and [[wealth management]].{{cite news|title=List of private banks by market capitalization |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/stocks/marketinfo/marketcap/bse/bank-private.html|website=moneycontrol.com|access-date=23 April 2019}} As of December 2023, the bank has 1,869 branches and 3,239 ATMs, including branches in [[GIFT City]] and [[Dubai International Financial Centre|DIFC (Dubai)]].{{Cite web |title=Press Release Q3FY24 |url=https://www.kotak.com/content/dam/Kotak/investor-relation/Financial-Result/QuarterlyReport/FY-2024/q3/PressRelease/Q3FY24-Press-Release.pdf}} ==History== ===1985–2002: Kotak Mahindra Finance=== In 1985, [[Uday Kotak]] founded Kotak Capital Management Finance Limited as a financial services company with a loan of {{INR}}30 [[lakh]] from family and friends.{{cite web |date=18 December 2020 |title=How Uday Kotak, world's richest banker, made $16 bn after a brush with death |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/people/how-uday-kotak-world-s-richest-banker-made-16-bn-after-a-brush-with-death-11608248541743.html |website=mint |language=en}} In 1986, [[Anand Mahindra]] and his father Harish Mahindra invested {{INR}}1 lakh in the company which was subsequently renamed Kotak Mahindra Finance.{{cite news |title=1 Lakh Investment Turned Into 1,400 Crores In 32 Years. This Is For Real |work=NDTV.com |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/1-lakh-investment-turned-into-1400-crores-in-32-years-this-is-for-real-1677458 |access-date=15 June 2022}} The company was initially engaged in bill discounting, along with [[Lease purchase contract|lease]] and [[hire purchase]] activities.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd. |work=Business Standard India |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/kotak-mah-bank-2330/information/company-history |access-date=15 June 2022}} In the early 1990s, the company started offering [[Car finance|car financing]] and [[investment banking]] services and expanded its operations overseas. In 1996, car financing company Kotak Mahindra Primus was incorporated as a 60:40 [[joint venture]] between Kotak Mahindra Finance and [[Ford Motor Credit Company|Ford Credit International]].{{cite news |last1=Philip |first1=Lijee |last2=Ganguli |first2=Bodhisatva |title=Kotak Mahindra to buy Ford's stake in Primus |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/kotak-mahindra-to-buy-fords-stake-in-primus/articleshow/1065720.cms |access-date=15 June 2022}} In the same year, Kotak Mahindra Finance hived off its investment banking division into a new company, Kotak Mahindra Capital, started in partnership with [[Goldman Sachs]].{{cite news |title=Retail brokerage's the key unit: Kotak |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/retail-brokerages-the-key-unit-kotak/articleshow/1451993.cms |access-date=22 October 2022}} In 1998, Kotak Mahindra Finance started its [[mutual fund]] arm called Kotak Mahindra AMC.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Company Limited |work=CARE Ratings |url=https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/05072021061859_Kotak_Mahindra_Asset_Management_Company_Limited.pdf |access-date=22 October 2022}} In 2001, OM Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance was established as a 74:26 joint venture between Kotak Mahindra Finance and [[Old Mutual]].{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra, Old Mutual get nod for life insurance JV |work=www.rediff.com |url=https://www.rediff.com/money/2001/jan/11kotak.htm |access-date=15 June 2022}} ===2003–present: Kotak Mahindra Bank=== [[File:ATM of Kotak in Shyambazar 01.jpg|thumb|A Kotak Mahindra Bank ATM in [[Kolkata]].]] In February 2003, Kotak Mahindra Finance received a [[Banking license|banking licence]] from the [[Reserve Bank of India]], becoming India's first [[Non-bank financial institution|non-banking finance company]] to be converted into a [[bank]]. Kotak Mahindra Finance was then renamed Kotak Mahindra Bank.{{cite news |title=RBI gives Kotak Mahindra banking licence |language=en |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/rbi-gives-kotak-mahindra-banking-licence/articleshow/36679056.cms |access-date=15 June 2022}} At the time, [[Uday Kotak]] had a 56% stake in the company while [[Anand Mahindra]] held a 5% stake.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Finance in limelight |work=www.rediff.com |url=https://www.rediff.com/money/2003/feb/07hot2.htm |access-date=15 June 2022}} In 2005, Kotak Mahindra Bank acquired Ford Credit's 40% stake in Kotak Mahindra Primus, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the group.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra, Ford to end JV |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/kotak-mahindra-ford-to-end-jv/articleshow/1129642.cms |access-date=15 June 2022 |work=The Economic Times}} Kotak Mahindra Primus was subsequently renamed as Kotak Mahindra Prime.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Prime Limited |url=https://www.icra.in/Rationale/ShowRationaleReport?Id=105600 |access-date=15 June 2022 |work=ICRA}} In 2006, Kotak Mahindra Bank bought out Goldman Sachs' 25% stake in Kotak Mahindra Capital for {{INRconvert|210|c|year=2006|mode=historical}} and 25% in Kotak Securities for {{INRconvert|123|c|year=2006|mode=historical}}, turning both companies into its wholly owned subsidiaries.{{cite news |title=Kotak, Goldman Sachs part ways - Global financial powerhouse plans $1-bn investment in India |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/kotak-goldman-sachs-part-ways-global-financial-powerhouse-plans-1-bn-investment-in-india/cid/809675 |access-date=22 October 2022 |work=The Telegraph}} In 2014, Kotak Mahindra Bank acquired a 15% stake in [[Multi Commodity Exchange]] (MCX) from [[Financial Technologies Group]] for {{INRconvert|459|c|mode=historical|year=2014}} to become the company's largest shareholder.{{cite news |title=Kotak to buy 15% stake in MCX for Rs 459 cr |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/kotak-to-buy-15-stake-in-mcx-for-rs-459-cr-114072100046_1.html |access-date=8 November 2022 |work=Business Standard |date=21 July 2014}} In 2014, Kotak Mahindra Bank announced the acquisition of [[ING Vysya Bank]] in a deal valued at {{INRConvert|15000|c|year=2015|mode=historical}}. With the merger completed in 2015, Kotak Mahindra Bank had almost 40,000 employees, and the number of branches reached 1,261.{{cite news|title=Kotak Bank acquires ING Vysya for INR 15,000 crore|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/industry-and-economy/banking/kotak-mahindra-board-okays-merger-of-ing-vysya-bank/article6618345.ece|access-date=15 April 2015|work=The Hindu|date=20 November 2014|location=Mumbai}} After the merger, [[ING Group]], which controlled [[ING Vysya Bank]], obtained a 6.5% stake in Kotak Mahindra Bank.{{cite news|title=ING Vysya staff seek job surety from Kotak|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/ing-vysya-staff-seek-job-surety-from-kotak-114120600080_1.html|newspaper=Business Standard India|publisher=BusinessStandard|access-date=15 April 2015|date=6 December 2014}} In 2015, [[Kotak Mahindra General Insurance]], a wholly owned subsidiary of Kotak Mahindra Bank, started operations after receiving [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority|IRDAI]]'s approval.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Gen Insurance gets IRDAI nod to commence biz |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/kotak-mahindra-gen-insurance-gets-irdai-nod-to-commence-biz-1422853.html |access-date=22 October 2022 |work=Moneycontrol |language=en}} In 2016, [[Bharti Airtel]] and Kotak Mahindra Bank started an 80:20 [[joint venture]] called [[Airtel Payments Bank]].{{cite news |title=Airtel Payments Bank launched, with vow to shake up old banking system |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/FxxxxsTZvCQuJt4I90upnK/Airtel-Payments-Bank-to-be-launched-today.html |access-date=1 May 2021 |work=mint |date=12 January 2017 |language=en}} In 2016, Kotak Mahindra Bank acquired BSS Microfinance for {{INRconvert|139.2|c|mode=historical|year=2016}}.{{cite news |last1=S |first1=Rajalakshmi |title=Kotak Bank to acquire 99.5% stake in BSS Microfinance |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/kotak-bank-to-acquire-995-stake-in-bss-microfinance/article9168578.ece |access-date=8 November 2022 |work=The Hindu Business Line |date=30 September 2016 |language=en}} In March 2017, Kotak Mahindra Bank launched an [[online savings account]] called Kotak 811,{{Cite web |last=Kotak811 |first=Kotak811 |title=About Kotak811 |url=https://www.kotak811.com/about-us }} named after the date Prime Minister [[Narendra Modi]] had announced [[2016 Indian banknote demonetisation|demonetisation]] in the previous year (8 November), which according to Uday Kotak was "the day that changed India."{{cite news |last1=Balakrishnan |first1=Ravi |title=Life after 8/11: Banks believe the customers will return, once they're done flirting with e-wallets |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/life-after-8/11-banks-believe-the-customers-will-return-once-theyre-done-flirting-with-e-wallets/articleshow/58802874.cms |access-date=7 November 2022 |work=The Economic Times |date=24 May 2017}}{{cite news |title=Kotak Bank Launches 811 'Zero Balance, Zero Charge' Account. Details Here |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/kotak-bank-launches-811-zero-balance-zero-charge-account-details-here-1675032 |access-date=7 November 2022 |work=NDTV}} Kotak 811 helped the bank double its number of customers by September 2018.{{cite news |title=How Kotak Mahindra Bank Scripted Marketing History |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/ad-marketing/how-kotak-mahindra-bank-scripted-marketing-history/58221/1 |access-date=7 November 2022 |work=Forbes India |language=en}} In April 2017, Kotak Mahindra Bank acquired Old Mutual's 26% stake in [[Kotak Life Insurance|Kotak Mahindra Old Mutual Life Insurance]] for {{INRconvert|1292|c|year=2017|mode=historical}}, making the life insurance company its wholly owned subsidiary.{{cite news |last1=Sinha |first1=Shilpy |title=Kotak to buy out Old Mutual in insurance JV |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/kotak-to-buy-out-old-mutual-in-insurance-jv/articleshow/58428668.cms |access-date=15 June 2022 |work=The Economic Times}} In 2021, Kotak Mahindra Bank sold its 8.57% stake in [[Airtel Payments Bank]] to [[Bharti Enterprises]] for {{INRconvert|295|c|year=2020|mode=historical}}.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Bank sells 20 crore shares in Airtel Payments Bank for Rs 295 crore |url=https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/kotak-mahindra-bank-sells-20-crore-shares-in-airtel-payments-bank-for-rs-295-cr/85854702 |access-date=22 October 2022 |work=Economic Times |language=en}} In the same year, Kotak Mahindra Group acquired the vehicle financing portfolio of [[Volkswagen Group|Volkswagen Finance India]]{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra acquires vehicle financing portfolio of Volkswagen Finance |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/kotak-mahindra-acquires-vehicle-financing-portfolio-of-volkswagen-finance-11631789114490.html |access-date=8 November 2022 |work=Mint |date=16 September 2021 |language=en}} and passenger vehicle financing portfolio of [[Ford Credit|Ford Credit India]].{{cite news |title=Kotak Prime acquires passenger vehicle financing portfolio of Ford Credit |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/kotak-prime-acquires-passenger-vehicle-financing-portfolio-of-ford-credit-11640176546172.html |access-date=8 November 2022 |work=Mint |date=22 December 2021 |language=en}} In 2022, it acquired the agriculture and healthcare equipment financing portfolio of [[DLL Group|DLL India]].{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Lalatendu |title=Kotak Mahindra Bank acquires agri, healthcare portfolio of DLL India |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/kotak-mahindra-bank-acquires-agri-healthcare-portfolio-of-dll-india/article65616090.ece |access-date=17 February 2023 |work=The Hindu |date=8 July 2022 |language=en-IN}} In 2023, Kotak Mahindra Bank acquired microfinancier Sonata Finance for {{INRconvert|537|c}}.{{cite news |title=Kotak Mahindra Bank acquires microlender Sonata for Rs 537 cr in all cash deal - ET BFSI |url=https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/nbfc/kotak-mahindra-bank-acquires-microlender-sonata-for-rs-537-cr-in-all-cash-deal/97850482 |access-date=17 February 2023 |work=Economic Times |language=en}} In February 2024, [[Zurich Insurance Group]] announced its acquisition of a 70% stake in [[Kotak Mahindra General Insurance]] for {{INRconvert|5560|c}}.{{cite news |title=Zurich Insurance to buy 70% stake in Kotak arm upfront in amended deal |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/zurich-insurance-to-buy-70-stake-in-kotak-arm-upfront-in-amended-deal/articleshow/107949522.cms |access-date=3 May 2024 |work=The Economic In 2020, Kotak pledged to donate {{INR|50 crore}} to the [[PM CARES Fund]] to fight against the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] in India.{{Cite web|date=29 March 2020|title=Kotak Mahindra Bank, Uday Kotak jointly pledge ₹50 to PM-CARES Fund|url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/kotak-mahindra-bank-uday-kotak-jointly-pledge-rs-50-crore-to-pm-cares-fund-11585477616252.html|access-date=2 July 2020|website=Livemint|language=en}} == Controversies == In April 2024, the [[Reserve Bank of India]] barred Kotak Mahindra Bank from onboarding new customers via mobile banking, online channels, and issuing new credit cards.{{Cite web |last=Vyas |first=Hitesh |date=2024-04-24 |title=RBI bars Kotak Mahindra Bank from onboarding new customers via online, mobile banking channels |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/banking-and-finance/rbi-bars-kotak-mahindra-bank-9288199/ |access-date=2024-05-15 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}} Existing customers were not affected. The RBI cited deficiencies in the bank's IT systems as the reason for this action.{{Cite news |last=Ghosh |first=Saptaparno |date=2024-05-07 |title=The Kotak Mahindra Bank controversy {{!}} Explained |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/the-kotak-mahindra-bank-controversy-explained/article68150904.ece |access-date=2024-05-15 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} On 25 March 2026, during a broader probe into the [[Haryana Government accounts fraud]], a discrepancy was uncovered at Kotak Mahindra Bank’s Sector-11 Panchkula branch involving Panchkula Municipal Corporation’s fixed deposits. When officials requested a transfer from a maturing deposit, reconciliation revealed ₹150 crore missing including a ₹58 crore deposit the bank said did not exist.{{Cite web |title=After IDFC fraud, Rs 150-crore scam detected in Panchkula MC’s account in Kotak Mahindra Bank |url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/haryana/after-idfc-fraud-150-crore-scam-detected-in-panchkula-mcs-account-in-kotak-mahindra-bank/ |access-date=2026-04-11 |website=The Tribune |language=en}} ==See also== * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[Indian Financial System Code]] ==References== {{reflist}}{{Cite web |date=13 August 2024 |title=Kotak811 Zero Balance Account |url=https://www.outlookindia.com/hub4business/why-zero-balance-savings-accounts-are-becoming-popular |publisher=Outlook India}} == External links == *{{Official website|https://www.kotak.bank.in}} == Further reading == *{{Cite journal |last1=Rohit Jain |first1=Neena |last2=Jaisinghani |first2=Dinesh |date=5 June 2017 |title=Overcoming the HR challenge: a case of merger of Kotak Mahindra Bank and ING Vysya Bank |url=https://www.emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/EEMCS-09-2016-0187/full/html |journal=Emerald Emerging Markets Case Studies |volume=7 |issue=2 |pages=1–16 |doi=10.1108/EEMCS-09-2016-0187|url-access=subscription }} *{{Cite journal |last1=Rao |first1=K.S. |last2=Kumar |first2=K. extract: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It offers banking products and financial services for corporate and retail customers in the areas of personal finance, investment banking, life insurance, and wealth management. As of December 2023, the bank has 1,869 branches and 3,239 ATMs, including branches in GIFT City and DIFC (Dubai).
